programme.title: The Moon Thieves

programme.title: Death Notice

programme.title: Love Punch

programme.title: Detrimental

programme.title: Raging Fire

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads 'FRANK', sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey?

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier & his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel.

programme.title: Trouble Girl

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: Inspector Yan's daughter is found dead, and her classmate Wen is arrested. However, when another killing occurs after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect that the true killer is still at large.

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Ad executive Lin uncovers her boyfriend's affair with a champion boxer and challenges her to a match. Under the former boxing legend's training, her quest for revenge evolves into self-discovery.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: A team of investigators was sent to an old building believed to be haunted by evil spirits, only to discover an unexpected secret concerning the future of the structure.

programme.title: There Is No Escape From Fate
programme.desc: An innocent Hong Kong businessman is wrongfully imprisoned in a brutal multinational prison, and must escape the sadistic warden's torture to survive.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy when he is sent to prison for embezzlement. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Septet : The Story of Hong Kong

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammer's clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds.

programme.title: Love Lies

programme.title: Dust to Dust

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhen's life takes a downturn after giving birth. Exhausted by childcare, ignored by her husband and burdened by in-laws and work, she endures lonely nights. Will dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Hail The Judge

programme.title: Shock Wave 2

programme.title: My Blue Summer

programme.title: Burning Blood

programme.title: Trending Topic

programme.desc: Two bears from the Institute of techonolgy have turned into humans after eating garlic and mugwort. Yet, one has grown up into a police, while one has become a gangster...

programme.title: The Favor
programme.desc: A family's prayers are answered by a mysterious savior, but as miracles spread, they uncover a chilling truth: every gift comes with a deadly curse.

programme.title: Escape
programme.desc: A North Korean soldier, Kyu-nam, embarks on an escape for a better future, while a State Security officer, Hyun-sang, relentlessly pursues him to protect the present in a deadly chase.

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting
programme.desc: During the extradition to Korea, a group of dangerous criminals united to stage an escape from the floating prison.

programme.title: The Hot-blooded
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened.

programme.title: A Millionaire's First Love
programme.desc: To inherit his grandfather's fortune, Jae-kyung has to transfer to a school in the countryside. He fell in love with a pretty girl Eun-hwan and is going to know about her secrets...

programme.title: Only God Knows Everything
programme.desc: Do-woon has just been ordained. During confession, a man admits to killing his mother. Torn between his duty as a priest and his desire for revenge as a son, he confronts a demonic group.

programme.title: Beautiful Vampire
programme.desc: A beautiful 500-year-old vampire has her carefully constructed quiet life put in jeopardy when she becomes attracted to her landlady's doltish son.

programme.title: Pawn
programme.desc: An unusual family is born as two ruthless loan sharks take in a little girl as collateral for unpaid debts.

programme.title: Life Is Beautiful
programme.desc: Se-yeon, devoted her entire life to her family, suddenly learns she is gravely ill. Now she is determined to live for herself more than ever and looks for her first love with the help of her husband.

programme.title: Firefighters
programme.desc: Based on the Hongje-dong fire accident in 2001, the movie depicts the harsh conditions that firefighters face every day as if it were their last mission to save lives and survive.

programme.title: Juror 8
programme.desc: Based on a true story, eight ordinary people of different backgrounds were selected as the first jury for a murder trial in South Korea in 2008.

programme.title: Dr. Cheon and the Lost Talisman
programme.desc: Dr. Cheon is a fake exorcist who cannot see or hear any ghosts. One day, a woman comes to Dr. Cheon, asking him to save her possessed younger sister...

programme.title: Road to Boston
programme.desc: A group of marathoners want to run proudly under the Korean flag after Korea's liberation. Though they couldn't afford a pair of sneakers, they embark on an unforgettable journey to Boston.

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Three gang members embroiled in fierce competition to vie for the boss's seat but all of them have their own dreams to achieve. So they try to offer each other the position instead.

programme.title: A Year-end Medley
programme.desc: From awkward first love to crush on a friend and long forgotten love, 14 love-struck individuals are brought together at Hotel Emross on New Year's Eve.

programme.title: The Witch: Part 2. the Other One
programme.desc: After a girl emerges as the sole survivor of a bloody raid on the research facility behind the top-secret Witch Program, she is rescued by a pair of civilians who soon realise that more danger lies ahead.

programme.title: Nocturnal
programme.desc: After his brother Seok-tae returns as a bloody corpse, Min-tae discovers the death of his brother was foretold in a novel, and Seok-tae's wife had a suspicious call with the novelist...

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
